prompt.zh-TW: 海風麵包坊這一期開始時沒有存貨。這一期進貨時全部借記存貨，合計 {{money:vars.purchases}}；賣出時記「借 營業成本／貸 存貨」，合計 {{money:vars.cogs}}；期末存貨帳戶餘額 {{money:vars.closing}}。教材版面的損益表上有「本期進貨」與「期末存貨(-)」兩列。這兩列的數字是怎麼來的？
prompt.en: Sea Breeze Bakery started the period with no inventory. During the period it debited inventory for every purchase, {{money:vars.purchases}} in total; on each sale it recorded debit cost of sales, credit inventory, {{money:vars.cogs}} in total; the inventory account’s closing balance is {{money:vars.closing}}. The course layout’s income statement has two lines, purchases and closing inventory (-). Where do those two figures come from?

text.zh-TW: 兩列都是由存貨帳推導出來的版面列，不是分錄裡的科目
text.en: Both are layout lines derived from the inventory account, not accounts used in entries

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。「本期進貨」是這一期借記存貨（進貨）的合計 {{money:vars.purchases}}，「期末存貨」是存貨帳戶的期末餘額 {{money:vars.closing}}。期初存貨加本期進貨減期末存貨，剛好等於營業成本帳戶的 {{money:vars.cogs}}；版面和分錄說的是同一件事。
feedback.en: That is right. Purchases is the total of this period’s inventory debits for purchases, {{money:vars.purchases}}, and closing inventory is the inventory account’s closing balance, {{money:vars.closing}}. Opening inventory plus purchases less closing inventory comes to exactly the {{money:vars.cogs}} in the cost of sales account; the layout and the entries describe the same thing.

text.zh-TW: 分錄裡要另外借記「本期進貨」科目、貸記「期末存貨」科目，版面才會有這兩列
text.en: The entries must separately debit a purchases account and credit a closing inventory account for the layout to show these lines

feedback.zh-TW: 你注意到版面有這兩列而分錄裡看不到，觀察很細。但網站採永續盤存，進貨直接記存貨；這兩列是由存貨帳算出來顯示的，不需要也沒有對應的科目。
feedback.en: You noticed that the layout shows two lines that the entries do not, a sharp observation. But the site keeps perpetual inventory, with purchases recorded straight into inventory; the two lines are computed from the inventory account for display and have no accounts of their own.

text.zh-TW: 進貨時就借記營業成本，所以「本期進貨」就是營業成本
text.en: Cost of sales is debited at purchase, so purchases equal cost of sales

feedback.zh-TW: 進貨與營業成本確實有關，這個聯想不算錯。但沒賣出去的貨還在店裡，是資產，不是成本；題目裡 {{money:vars.purchases}} 的進貨只有 {{money:vars.cogs}} 變成營業成本，剩下的 {{money:vars.closing}} 還是存貨。
feedback.en: Purchases and cost of sales are indeed related, so the association is understandable. But unsold goods are still in the shop and are an asset, not a cost; of the {{money:vars.purchases}} purchased, only {{money:vars.cogs}} became cost of sales and the remaining {{money:vars.closing}} is still inventory.

explanation.zh-TW: {{option:o_g7h8}}：網站的帳採永續盤存制，分錄只有「借 存貨」與「借 營業成本／貸 存貨」兩種標準寫法；教材版面則用期初、進貨、期末三列的加減呈現同一個營業成本。{{option:o_j9k1}}把版面列當成科目；{{option:o_m2n3}}把進貨全當成成本。
explanation.en: {{option:o_g7h8}}: the site’s books use the perpetual inventory system, with only two standard entries, debit inventory and debit cost of sales, credit inventory; the course layout presents the same cost of sales through three lines, opening, purchases and closing, added and subtracted. {{option:o_j9k1}} treats layout lines as accounts; {{option:o_m2n3}} treats all purchases as cost.
